title: Entity
description: Structural domain model object primitive in the SDLC Factory

id.description: Unique identifier for the Entity instance

name.description: Name of the domain entity (e.g. Member, Book, Loan)

domain.description: Domain or Bounded Context (e.g. LibraryManagement, Payments)

attributes.description: Attributes and field definitions for this entity

isPrototype.description: Whether this entity acts as a prototype for cloning (ADR-002)

prototypeId.description: ID of parent prototype if cloned from another entity

position.description: Gapped position key for deterministic sort order (10, 20, 30...)
